setup-worktree: if [ "$(git -C "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH" branch --show-current)" = "dev" ] && [ -z "$(git -C "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH" status --porcelain)" ] && git -C "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH" merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/dev; then git -C "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH" merge --ff-only origin/dev && (cd "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH" && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile); fi
if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] && [ "$(git rev-list --count origin/dev..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 1)" -eq 0 ]; then git reset --hard origin/dev; fi
